SELECT p.*, owner.employee_name AS owner_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_training_session s WHERE s.plan_id = p.id AND s.deleted = FALSE) AS actual_session_count FROM biz_training_plan p LEFT JOIN org_employee owner ON owner.employee_no = p.owner_no AND owner.deleted = FALSE
ORDER BY p.${sortColumn} ${sortDirection} NULLS LAST, p.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
